默认关闭。开启后，房间等你回答时 MOSS 立即告诉你，其他事攒到简报时间一起说: Off by default. When on, MOSS tells you right away when a room is waiting for your answer and saves everything else for the digest. It reports only during active hours and uses the quota of MOSS's software.
还没有职责，MOSS 不会主动汇报。在对话里交代一句即可，例如“有房间等我回答时: No duties yet, so MOSS won't report. Tell it in the conversation, for example “Remind me when a room is waiting for my answer”, and it will note it.

告诉你各房间现在怎么样、哪里在等你。: Tell you how each room is doing and where you're needed.
